scope: New source-level Type9 command encoding facts; no hardware operation
newly_established_by_independent_truth_t: Inferno opcode 6 with flag_mode=0 produces LP5 MRW-1 CA positive/negative phases; mode=1 produces MRW-2. All 128 MA x 256 OP cases match LiteDRAM.
Inferno opcode 15 produces LP5 MRR CA phases for all 128 MA values.
Inferno opcode 25 produces LP5 MPC CA phases for all 256 OP values at the truth-table level.
Descriptor d3 and d4 are CA phase bitmaps, not opaque ARC instructions. Their lower seven bits form the first and second CA phases of LP5's DDR command bus.
A type6 fast-path tracker holds MRW-1 in slot0 and MRW-2 in slot1 for the same rank selection. The header's channel0/channel1 slot labels are not reliable semantic documentation.
LP4 MRW uses four successive rising CK edges, CS=1,0,1,0. Its CA values are 0x06|OP7<<5, MA[5:0], 0x16|OP6<<5, OP[5:0].
LP4 MPC uses two successive rising CK edges, CS=1,0. ZQ start operand is 0x4f and latch is 0x51, unlike LP5 operands 0x85/0x86.

software_descriptor_fields.d0: Set to 1 by flags[6] or val_arg1[1]; physical meaning not independently identified.
software_descriptor_fields.d1: Initialized to zero by pmu_cal_multi_branch_dispatch; can be altered by tracker flow. Physical meaning unknown.
software_descriptor_fields.d2: Set to 1 by flags[15]. Physical meaning unknown.
software_descriptor_fields.d3: First 7-bit LP5 CA phase, independently corroborated for MRW/MRR/MPC.
software_descriptor_fields.d4: Second 7-bit LP5 CA phase, independently corroborated for MRW/MRR/MPC.
software_descriptor_fields.d5: val_arg1[1:0], unless flags[16] or opcode40 second phase suppresses it. Rank-selection input at callers; correspondence to active-high physical CS pins in LP4 is not established.
software_descriptor_fields.d6_bit0: Set on selected read paths when flags[3:2]==3, or by flags[18]. Physical function unknown.
software_descriptor_fields.d6_bit1: Set on selected read opcodes unless flags[3], or by flags[18]. Read-enable candidate, not independently proved.
software_descriptor_fields.d6_bit2: Set for LP5 write opcodes 3/4/28 and WFF opcode41. Write-enable candidate, not independently proved.
software_descriptor_fields.d7_bits11_0: Priority selection from flags[20..27]: 0x00d,0x0d0,0xd00,0x008,0x080,0x400,0x100,0x200; otherwise zero. Physical controls unknown, cannot assume they are RESET_n or CKE.

packed_command_ram_bits.word0_bits15_14: d5[1:0]: caller rank selection, physical CS semantics in LP4 unproved
packed_command_ram_bits.word1_bits3_0: d6[3:0]: data/control flags with only call-site correlations
packed_command_ram_bits.word2_bit0: d7[12], source flags[19]: unknown physical control
packed_command_ram_bits.word3_bit4: d0[0]: flags[6] or input rank-selection bit1; unknown hardware purpose
packed_command_ram_bits.word3_bits9_8: slot0 uses tracker[18][1:0], slot1 uses tracker[16][1:0]: unknown step modes
packed_command_ram_bits.word3_bit10_slot0: Nonzero cbt_step_ext converted to 1; physical timing interpretation unknown
packed_command_ram_bits.word3_bit11_slot0: tracker[20][0] commit flag; physical timing interpretation unknown
packed_command_ram_bits.word3_bits14_12_slot0: tracker[17][2:0], software repeat count minus one
packed_command_ram_bits.word3_bits14_10_slot1: tracker[17][7:3], remainder of software repeat count minus one

execution_path_source_facts.commit: Two slots, eight packed halfwords, marker += 8; marker/4 is number of slots.
execution_path_source_facts.start_candidate: ARC 0x90040044 + (active_csr_offset << 1), set to 0 in pulse init
execution_path_source_facts.completion_candidate: ARC 0x90040042, poll nonzero with 25000-iteration bound in public source
execution_path_source_facts.qualification: Source-level behavior established; names start/stop/launch/completion are inferred from call relationships, not validated against an authoritative Type9 register manual or T736 measurements.
execution_path_source_facts.host_mapping: Not established for command RAM. Known mailbox host/ARC addresses do not justify a global linear mapping. No host writes generated.

operations_status.MRW: LP4 pin encoding implemented and exhaustively checked. Type9 LP4 SDR timing/rank control not established.
operations_status.MRR: LP4 request pin encoding mirrors public DFI adapter and is exhaustively checked. Type9 read capture, validity and DQ extraction are absent.
operations_status.ZQ: LP4 ZQ start/latch MPC pin encodings implemented. Timing, shared-resistor serialization and execution remain caller/backend obligations.
operations_status.RESET: Not a CA command. RESET_n/CKE physical CSR control and LP4 power-up timing cannot be inferred from d7 flags; no reset executor added.
operations_status.CBT: MR13 can be encoded as an ordinary MRW. This does not implement CBT: CKE transitions, FSP selection, DQ Vref/CA feedback control, training and safe exit are unimplemented.

critical_unresolved_mapping: Does LP4 mode expand one d3/d4 pair into two SDR cycles, or must each CA value occupy a full slot with repeated positive/negative phases?
How is LP4 CS high/low alternation represented? LP5 has a single SDR CS value per two DDR CA phases; a rank mask is insufficient to infer LP4 behavior.
Which mode/ratio register establishes command period and descriptor repeat-count units?
What are every d6/d7 control flag's physical side effects, and which values are required for plain LP4 MRW without disturbing reset/CKE/data lanes?
How are completion status stale bits cleared and failures recovered before a new sequence? Public source only polls nonzero; first hardware executor must establish fresh completion semantics.

followup_execution_audit.scope: Host upload ABI and existing public-source call graph only; no vendor PMU/PIE payload inspection or translation, no hardware operation

sdk_host_upload_aperture.observed_host_interface: Both routines set host PHY mux0, then clear eight consecutive 16-bit locations at 0x0a982000..0x0a98200e before their program upload. LP4 literal pool offsets0x304/0x308 identify mux0x0aaa0000 and destination0x0a982000.
sdk_host_upload_aperture.conclusion: 0x0a982000 is a directly observed host command/program upload aperture. It is a stronger candidate for the ARC0x90082000 command RAM than a global mailbox-derived delta, but this does not independently prove host/ARC aliasing or LP4 instruction semantics.
sdk_host_upload_aperture.forbidden_inference: Do not treat the uploaded opaque program's words as source, decode it into executable tables, or assume the host aperture can be written during live DRAM operation.

fresh_done_source_audit.facts: All identified reads of PHY_REG_CLK_GATE_STAT/ARC0x90040042 only test nonzero. The public source writes1 to ARC0x90040040 before polling and0 after nonzero; no status-clear write, low-state precondition, generation counter, or low-to-high completion edge is established.
fresh_done_source_audit.conclusion: A zero-then-launch-then-nonzero executor would still invent the low/clear semantics. No executor or recovery sequence added.

mrr_capture_source_audit.facts: The identified literal opcode15 call sets flags18 (d6=3), supplies slice_target as MR-address operand, passes rank-mask argument0, and repeats through extra=vref_step. Surrounding operations toggle a DBYTE broadcast control and a secondary calibration strobe. The function returns void and reads no receive-data/valid register.
mrr_capture_source_audit.conclusion: This is not a complete per-rank MRR response helper. Neither the read-enable correlation of d6 nor this call supplies LP4 capture, validity, or DQ extraction semantics. The separate controller MRR diagnostic cannot replace a first PHY training receive path.

misleading_public_names.fact: pmu_is_lpddr4() only evaluates (DMEM MR19 byte0x8a &3)==1; pmu_is_lpddr5() similarly checks MR20 byte0x8e bits1:0. These helper names do not establish a DRAM-type switch or an LP4 command backend.
misleading_public_names.conclusion: Do not select LP4 execution based on these names.

rejected_cross_version_mapping.facts: Public Odyssey D5ACSM Run/Done are CSR0x11d/0x11e, Start/Stop0x12b/0x12c, RxEn/RxVal/TxEn pulses0x120/0x121/0x122. These differ from the Type9 candidate offsets0x20/0x21/0x22/0x23; no field mapping was imported.
rejected_cross_version_mapping.additional_search_result: Targeted public ACSM/LP4-mode searches found older ST/NXP/Tesla DfiCAMode/AcsmCtrl interfaces, not an independently documented Type9 LP4 slot layout. Opaque public PIE programs were not used.

remaining_minimum_specification: LP4 CA/CS timing per four-halfword slot, including the effect of PHY LP4 mode and clock ratio
d6/d7 physical outputs and safe inactive values for CKE/RESET/data drivers
Per-lane receive capture trigger, freshness/error bits and byte routing

hardware_test_gate: Do not execute or flash the LP5 program or a guessed LP4 slot mapping. Establish the above mapping, then validate from SRAM with source-built firmware and observable MRW/MRR results.
